$comment: Source list for the bundled ontology library packs. generate.py is the only writer of the manifests and payloads this file describes. Upstream payloads are published verbatim at a pinned URL and verified by downloadSha256; authored packs are OpenMetadata-written outlines whose payload is checked in by hand.
allowedLicenses: W3C Software and Document License or OGC Software License

packs.name: DCAT 3
packs.description: The W3C vocabulary for describing data catalogs, datasets, distributions and data services, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: DCAT Version 3, W3C Recommendation. Copyright W3C. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: DCAT 3 vocabulary
modules.description: Catalogs, datasets, distributions, data services and their relationships.

packs.name: PROV-O
packs.description: The W3C provenance ontology for describing entities, activities and agents, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology, W3C Recommendation 30 April 2013. Copyright W3C (MIT, ERCIM, Keio, Beihang). Used under the W3C Software and Document License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: PROV-O
modules.description: Entities, activities, agents and the derivation, attribution and usage relations between them.

packs.name: W3C Organization Ontology
packs.description: The W3C ontology for organizational structure: organizations, units, roles, posts and membership, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: The Organization Ontology, W3C Recommendation 16 January 2014. Copyright W3C. The ontology file declares the Open Data Commons PDDL 1.0; the Recommendation text is under the W3C Document License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: Organization ontology
modules.description: Organizations, organizational units, sites, posts, roles and memberships.

packs.name: OWL-Time
packs.description: The W3C and OGC ontology of temporal concepts: instants, intervals, durations and calendar-clock descriptions, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: Time Ontology in OWL, W3C Recommendation. Copyright 2006-2017 W3C, OGC. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. W3C and OGC liability, trademark and document use rules apply. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: OWL-Time
modules.description: Temporal entities, positions, durations, calendar and clock descriptions, and Allen interval relations.

packs.name: SOSA and SSN
packs.description: The W3C and OGC sensor, observation, sampling and actuation vocabulary. SOSA is the lightweight core; SSN adds systems, deployments and stimuli on top of it. Published verbatim.
packs.license: W3C Software and Document License or OGC Software License
packs.attribution: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology, W3C Recommendation and OGC Implementation Standard 19 October 2017. Copyright 2017 W3C/OGC. Used under the W3C Software and Document License or the OGC Software License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: SOSA
modules.description: Sensors, observations, samples, actuators and the platforms that host them.

modules.name: SSN
modules.description: Systems, deployments, stimuli and properties layered on SOSA.

packs.name: ODRL 2.2
packs.description: The W3C Open Digital Rights Language vocabulary for policies, permissions, prohibitions, duties and constraints, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: ODRL Vocabulary and Expression 2.2, W3C Recommendation 15 February 2018. Copyright W3C. Used under the W3C Document License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: ODRL 2.2 vocabulary
modules.description: Policies, rules, actions, constraints, parties and assets.

packs.name: FOAF
packs.description: The Friend of a Friend vocabulary for people, groups, accounts and documents, published verbatim as RDF/XML.
packs.attribution: FOAF Vocabulary Specification 0.99 (Paddington Edition, 14 January 2014), Dan Brickley and Libby Miller. Licensed under CC BY 1.0. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: FOAF vocabulary
modules.description: Persons, agents, groups, organizations, accounts, documents and images.

packs.name: Data Privacy Vocabulary
packs.publisher: W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group
packs.description: The W3C community vocabulary for personal data processing: purposes, processing, legal bases, data subjects and technical measures, plus the personal-data categories extension. Published verbatim.
packs.attribution: Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) 2.3, W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group. Copyright W3C. Used under the W3C Software and Document License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: DPV core
modules.description: Core concepts for personal data handling, purposes, processing, legal bases and measures.

modules.name: Personal data categories
modules.description: The personal-data extension: categories of personal data such as identifiers, contact details and financial data.

packs.name: GS1 Web Vocabulary
packs.description: The GS1 Web Vocabulary for products, organizations, places, offers and the GS1 code lists, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: GS1 Web Vocabulary 1.18. Copyright 2015-2019 GS1 AISBL. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. GS1 and the GS1 logo are registered trademarks of GS1 AISBL. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: GS1 Web Vocabulary
modules.description: Products, organizations, places, offers, certifications and code lists.

packs.name: FIBO
packs.standard: Financial Industry Business Ontology, production quickstart
packs.description: The Financial Industry Business Ontology production release as one merged file, including the OMG Commons and Languages, Countries and Codes terms. Published verbatim.
packs.attribution: Financial Industry Business Ontology (FIBO) production quickstart 2026Q2. Copyright 2018-2026 EDM Council Inc. Copyright 2018-2025 Object Management Group, Inc. Licensed under the MIT License. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: FIBO production quickstart
modules.description: All production FIBO modules merged into one ontology.

packs.name: HL7 FHIR R5
packs.description: The FHIR R5 resource and element ontology. It carries no value sets or code systems. Published verbatim.
packs.attribution: HL7 FHIR Release 5 (5.0.0) RDF ontology, published by HL7 International under CC0 1.0 (https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/license.html). HL7 and FHIR are registered trademarks of Health Level Seven International. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: FHIR R5 ontology
modules.description: FHIR resources, data types and their elements.

packs.name: Brick Schema
packs.description: The Brick schema for building equipment, spaces, points and the relationships between them, published verbatim.
packs.attribution: Brick Schema 1.4.2. Copyright 2016-2026, Brick Consortium, Inc. All rights reserved. Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted under the BSD 3-Clause License. The name of the Brick Consortium may not be used to endorse products derived from this software without permission. Redistributed without changes.

modules.name: Brick schema
modules.description: Equipment, locations, points, collections and the Brick relationships.

packs.name: ISA-95 Starter (OpenMetadata-authored)
packs.description: An OpenMetadata-authored concept outline aligned to the ANSI/ISA-95 equipment hierarchy and resource model. It is not the ISA-95 standard, which is a paid publication, and it does not reproduce its text.
packs.attribution: Written by the OpenMetadata project and licensed under the Apache License 2.0 as part of OpenMetadata. Aligned to ANSI/ISA-95; ISA-95 is a standard of the International Society of Automation and is not licensed to this project.

modules.name: Manufacturing operations
modules.description: A role-based equipment hierarchy and resource outline aligned to ISA-95.

packs.name: HR Open Starter (OpenMetadata-authored)
packs.description: An OpenMetadata-authored concept outline aligned to HR Open Standards workforce concepts. HR Open publishes no RDF form of its standard, so this is not a copy of it.
packs.attribution: Written by the OpenMetadata project and licensed under the Apache License 2.0 as part of OpenMetadata. Aligned to HR Open Standards, which are not licensed to this project.

modules.name: Workforce
modules.description: Workers, positions, organizations and compensation concepts aligned to HR Open.

packs.name: EPCIS Starter (OpenMetadata-authored)
packs.description: An OpenMetadata-authored concept outline aligned to GS1 EPCIS supply-chain events. The GS1 EPCIS ontology carries no license grant we could confirm, so this is not a copy of it.
packs.attribution: Written by the OpenMetadata project and licensed under the Apache License 2.0 as part of OpenMetadata. Aligned to GS1 EPCIS; GS1 and EPCIS are trademarks of GS1 AISBL.

modules.name: Event model
modules.description: Event types and the what, when, where and why dimensions aligned to EPCIS.

excluded.name: schema.org
excluded.reason: CC BY-SA 3.0. Share-alike terms need legal review before the vocabulary can ship inside an Apache-2.0 distribution.

excluded.name: GS1 EPCIS and CBV ontologies
excluded.reason: The files carry no license grant and GS1 IP policy terms for non-members are unconfirmed. The EPCIS starter is OpenMetadata-authored instead.

excluded.name: DCMI Terms
excluded.reason: The file carries no license statement and the CC BY 4.0 claim on the DCMI site is unconfirmed.

excluded.name: ETSI SAREF
excluded.reason: The ETSI Software License text could not be retrieved, so its terms are unconfirmed.

excluded.name: QUDT
excluded.reason: Not evaluated. Its file header carries a UCUM license notice that would need its own review.

excluded.name: ISA-95 and IEC 62264
excluded.reason: A paid standard with no official open ontology. The ISA-95 starter is OpenMetadata-authored.

excluded.name: HR Open Standards
excluded.reason: No official RDF or OWL form. The HR Open starter is OpenMetadata-authored.
